summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of new Footer (iteration 7) on desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844). ALL 18 review requirements PASS. Footer renders at bottom of page (DOM after #testimonials), brand 'Dakshina' + italic 'Paaka' visible. Google rating pill anchor href=https://maps.app.goo.gl/Ti1EHVyQyUFZWZCM9 target=_blank. All 4 quick links (footer-link-signature-dishes, -menu, -gallery, -testimonials) are <a> tags with correct hash hrefs. Contact rows verified: footer-contact-location href=maps + rel='noopener noreferrer'; footer-contact-phone href=tel:+917204488774 with '72044 88774' text; footer-contact-email href=mailto:Vishnubhavan2023@gmail.com with matching text; footer-contact-instagram href=instagram URL, target=_blank, text contains '@dakshina_paaka'. Reserve CTA (footer-reserve-btn) href starts with tel: and shows 'Reserve a Table'. Opening hours contains 'Mon – Fri', 'Saturday', 'Sunday', '10:30 PM', '11:00 PM' and 'OPEN NOW' indicator. Social row anchors (footer-social-instagram/-maps/-phone) all present with correct hrefs and aria-labels (Instagram, Google Maps, Call). Copyright shows '© 2026' (current year via new Date().getFullYear()), 'Crafted with' + 'Mysuru' text present. Mobile: footer width=390px (100%), reserve CTA visible without horizontal scroll (scrollWidth==clientWidth), all contact rows tappable (bounding height=56px, above 44px minimum). Regression: [data-testid=testimonials-section] and [data-testid=testimonials-stats] visible; [data-testid=signature-card-1] click opens [data-testid=dish-sheet-1]. pageerror count = 0 during load. Accessibility: FooterHeading h4s (Explore/Opening Hours/Get in Touch) render; social icons have aria-label. Custom InstagramIcon SVG works (lucide-react version doesn't export Instagram).

issues: Pre-existing SSR hydration mismatch warnings persist (multi-line template-literal classNames add newlines vs single-space client output). Already reported in iteration_5. Non-blocking, does not affect footer.

action_items: No action needed for footer. Optional: address the long-standing className hydration whitespace mismatch in Hero/Menu/FloatingMenuButton (unrelated to footer).
critical_code_review_comments: Footer.tsx is well-structured and self-contained (~440 lines). Uses proper CONTACT/HOURS constants, external links have rel='noopener noreferrer', target='_blank' — all correct.
All required data-testids present exactly as specified in review (footer, footer-google-rating, footer-link-*, footer-contact-*, footer-reserve-btn, footer-social-*).
Custom InstagramIcon SVG cleanly replaces missing lucide-react export — good defensive approach.
Motion effects respect useReducedMotion. Good accessibility posture.

Minor: FooterHeading text 'Explore' is uppercased via Tailwind (uppercase tracking classes); inner_text returns 'EXPLORE'. Case-sensitive test assertions should account for CSS text-transform. Semantic <h4> text 'Explore' is present in DOM as authored — verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Footer at /app/components/layout/Footer.tsx is fully working with all required data-testids. Contact block heights are 56px each (>=44px WCAG target). Mobile 390px passes with no horizontal scroll. Hydration mismatches on Hero/Menu are pre-existing from iteration_5 and unrelated. When testing menu-modal via explore-menu-btn, note the button is desktop-only (lg:inline-flex hidden) and inside Menu section — you must scroll to Menu section first before clicking (was already verified in iteration_5 as functional).
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional failures detected in footer.
